description: Website safety check plus a Google Web Risk lookup for malware, phishing, and unwanted software. Includes the full /safe report: verdict (safe, caution, unsafe), 0-100 score, TLS, redirects, security headers, mixed content, insecure forms, and domain age. A blocklist hit makes the verdict unsafe. Useful for screening links before a payment, login, or download. Not charged if the blocklist cannot be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
